notes.title: Minor Patch Notes
notes.content:
Reduced the score requirements for Greed Beyond Measure from 800 to 500
 Slightly increased the amount of time you have to make it into the dark portal

notes.title: Easy Mode Enabled!
notes.content:
Greetings Heroes!

Today I'm switching on the most requested feature for Hero's Descent, an easy mode! You can toggle this feature at any time when selecting a game mode to play. This mode does not disable any unlocks or achievements, as I want everyone to be able to enjoy Hero's Descent at their own pace.

Easy Mode Details

 All characters have their health and mana values doubled
 Mana regens twice as fast upon killing enemies
 Par times are increased by 30%
 All characters have their attack values increased by 1 (This may sound small, but you're effectively twice as powerful in the early game!)
 Enemies are less aggressive
 Upgrades cost half as much in the shop


Other Patch Nodes

 Daily Challenge is temporarily disabled in Easy Mode. I'm working on a way to get this functional here, so stay tuned
 New leaderboards have been created for Easy Mode
 Re-wrote callback handlers for Steam functions. Leaderboard uploads/downloads should be faster and more consistent now

notes.title: Bug fixes and other improvements
notes.content:
Hello again, heroes!

In addition to today's achievement content patch, I've deployed some other minor fixes:


 Speedrunners rejoice, you can now disable boss death animations in the options menu
 The Reaper in  now waits an extra 2 turns before coming active
 Berserker par times in the first region have been increased by 15%, and an additional 20% on the boss stage. No more forced misses on Slime Queen's Revenge.
 Fixed a bug with the Burninator achievement
 Fixed a bug with the Terror Awaits You in the Fjord achievement
 (Hopefully) fixed a bug resulting in a softlock when you attempt to upload a new score
 Secondary layered sound effects (stopwatch, weather, etc) should now respect the "Mute Sfx" option

notes.title: Hero's Descent achievements update!
notes.content:
Greetings heroes!

I've added a collection of new achievements to the game, and your clients should be automatically updating shortly. Many of these achievements are tricky to obtain, and you may want to look at the descriptions or icons for some clues. Best of luck!

With this update, the following bugs have also been fixed:

 An invisible wall was removed from The Gardens
 Quitting the application should work universally now

notes.title: Backend and Leaderboards Update
notes.content:
Hi again!

Our old backend provider was somewhat unstable, so I've gone ahead and ported to using Steam entirely. You'll likely notice faster load times, and score/time uploads should be much more stable.

Unfortunately, this does mean the leaderboards will be wiped. Now's the time to conquer first place, and maybe you'll be the first to clear Reality's Edge!

notes.title: Achievements and Assorted Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I've pushed a build today that includes a number of new Steam Achievements, and fixes the existing ones as well. If you've already earned the achievements ingame, simply boot the game up and exit, and everything should sync up.

I'll likely add some more, let me know in the forums if you have any ideas for fun ones.

Additionally, a few other gameplay and bug fix patches have been added, courtesy of Josh Jordan, the current Berserker record holder:


 Berserkers no longer get mana potions. Any time a mana potion would drop, a health potion drops instead
 Berserkers no longer have useless mana regen floating text popups in combat
 The mana upgrade slot is now skipped on the upgrade screen
 The Dervish passive for Berserker no longer kills you when you attack a door
 Shield and Health are displayed separately in the UI
 Health values below zero are no longer displayed

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content:
Some small fixes:

 The Berserker passive "Dervish" no longer considers the player to be an active target
 High score/fastest time uploads should be a bit more resilient, and will log more information upon failure

notes.title: Hero's Descent Major Update - 100% Free + Major Improvements and Fixes
notes.content:
We've opted to make Hero's Descent fully free! There are no microtransactions or other fees involved. Simply download the game and have fun.

This pricing change should take place on March 29th.

In addition to this, we've made the following updates to the game:

 Improved Steam Deck support. The game is now 100% playable on the deck, and it's even our preferred way to play!
 All major bugs identified by players have been fixed. As always, let us know if you find more!
 Bosses and monsters have been rebalanced to make the game notably easier


As always, you can chat with me, report bugs, or check out other projects in development in the Dan Makes Video Games Official Discord.

notes.title: Early Access Patch #1
notes.content:
Hello Early Access folks!

Tonight I'm pushing the first (of many) Early Access update to the live build. As always, there may be bugs, so please let me know if you run into anything. The easiest way to report issues is on the Discord (https://discord.gg/pRSdCcE) or on the Community Forums.

Patch Notes

General Gameplay

 A mysterious portal has resumed appearing
 Fixed issues with the  area and its rewards
 A new version of the final boss may appear under certain circumstances. Good luck beating this one! (This boss may be replaced with a more unique true final boss at a later date)
 Players brave enough to complete the game under the maximum level of difficulty will be rewarded with a special indicator on the leaderboards


Balance

 The Berserker Trait, "Axes of Evil", now has its countdown timer increased by 1 turn when hitting an enemy. This should make the stat requirements for surviving the second area's boss less stringent


Interface

 The tutorial text should no longer have formatting issues under certain circumstances
 The Druid and Dragon entries in the Codex now show the proper unlocked state
 The post-boss score screen now properly displays the PAR and NO DAMAGE bonuses


Other Bug Fixes

 Players who die before the first boss no longer will register a score of 0 on the leaderboards
 Killing the sub-bosses during the Fairy Queen had a small chance of causing a soft-lock, this should no longer be the case


 Known Issues

 The time leaderboards were wiped due to a DB upgrade. Given the small number of people finishing the game, this is not worth restoring. Sorry about that!

notes.title: Super Big Progression Revamp Update
notes.content:
A major update has just been pushed to Steam for OSX and Windows, and should be available shortly. This update focuses on cleaning up the progression system, reducing the amount of time spent in menus, and reducing character stat bloat.

If you haven't tried the game in a while, this is probably a good place to jump in! As always, feedback is greatly appreciated.

Progression Changes:

The "Level Complete" screen has been removed entirely. Transitions between levels in the same world now happen as soon as the player reaches the exit
Monsters and treasures chests no longer directly reward experience or score
Upon killing the boss of a world and exiting the arena, a new "World Complete" screen will appear
The "World Complete" screen now gives you a grade, representing an evaluation of your overall skill in completing the levels in that world
Grades range from "F" to "S".
Your grade is determined by the number of levels in which you beat the par time, the number in which you do not take damage, and the total treasure you have discovered
Grades confer bonus experience and score, with the "S" rank awarding a massive boost
The "Level Up" screen now appears after "World Complete"
The amount of experience required to purchase stat upgrades has increased substantially
Purchasing traits continues to function as it did prior to this update
The Dark World continues to award progression in the same way it did before


Balance Changes:

Monster health has been reduced by 25-40% to account for player stats being lowered
The Angel heals for less and no longer shields enemies
The Bat's attack power has been reduced to 2
The Slime Queen levels up more slowly when drawing magic from Slime Royals
Spells gain potency or effectiveness with each individual point spent in Magic now, in order to reduce confusion


Gameplay/UI Changes:

Upon completing a stage, the camera will rapidly fade out, starting from the farthest area away from the player. When the next stage loads, this effect will reverse. This makes it substantially easier to tell where the player is when starting a new stage
The Slime Queen's Revenge and The Fairy Queen's Domain have been enabled under certain conditions
An animation has been added to indicate an invalid move
Character and enemy movement animations will appear more smooth during frame drops
Characters and enemies will not display negative health values while dying
Floating combat text will no longer render for uninteresting events
A new "Ambush!" text appears when certain enemies attack the player
Sound effects have been added to more actions
Some screens have had their text reduced
The tutorial has been updated to match the new game systems
The Dark World's access requirements have been made slightly easier
New entries have been added to the Codex
The Slime Queen should no longer litter
Storm of Greed now appears in 5% of stages
Storm of Darkness now appears in 5% of stages
Storm of Bones now appears in 5% of stages
All magical storms can activate in boss fights
Enemies under the effect of Time Stop will be revealed regardless of light during a Storm of Darkness


Unlocks:

Complete the game once unlocks: Wizard, Magical Storms, Additional Bosses
Complete the game as Wizard unlocks: A Temporal Distortion, Berserker

notes.title: Hero's Descent Summer Patch
notes.content:
A new update has just gone live! This includes major revamps to character balance, the battle system, and adds a ton of new content. Additionally, controllers are now fully supported!

Some highlights:

Characters

 All 3 characters have a plethora of new traits
 The Wizard has learned a third spell, Frost Breath
 Upgrade cost tables have been redone for every character
 New character-specific achievements have been added


Content

 8 new areas have been added to the map pool
 Doors and traps have been added to the Castle and Caverns
 New enemy: Bat
 New enemy: Snake
 New enemy: Angel
 New enemy: Beholder
 New enemy: Wraith
 New enemy: Spider
 The Fairy Queen fight has been redone
 Various enemy stats have been tweaked


Systems

 Controllers are now fully supported
 Key and control mapping is now implemented
 The UI has been redone
 The font has been replaced with a more retro version
 Experimental death replays have been added

notes.title: Hero's Descent v.11 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Change Summary (Spoiler-free):   
You can now pause the game and view your current stats/traits
"Restart" has been added as an option in the pause menu. This is disabled during a Daily Challenge
"Quit" has been added as an option in the pause menu
"Quit Game" has been added to the main menu
Skills, traits, achievements, and various other things have new icons more in-line with the art style
Slight changes to the way your skills are displayed ingame
The Beholder and Angel now have Codex entries
More changes to aspect ratio support. 16:10 now has a letterbox effect in order to display the entire level without stretching the art
All levels have been remade to be two tiles wider
The Lost Cells have been added to area 2
The ugly Unity options menu is gone and has been replaced by real options. These persist locally for now, but I've opted not to persist them in the Steam Cloud, since I assume your graphics options will vary from computer to computer. Instead, I try to default to the settings that should make the most sense for your setup.
Various UI issues have been tweaked/fixed
You can now play the game in offline mode. This disables the Leaderboards for your current session
Riposte has replaced Zap for the Hero. This skill allows you to counterattack most incoming attacks, and prevents all damage from them, for a few turns.
Some monsters have had their balance values tweaked
Fixed a bug where getting a game over when running in Steam could cause you to be unable to save your progress/start a new game
Fixed the modal dialog behind the game over screen
Started adding Steam Achievements
Floating combat text now fades as it rises to help you focus on the most recent event
Floating combat text is now more robust and informative. For example, using a skill without the proper mana will trigger some text informing you of such
Enemies now drop powerups
The Stopwatch has been added to the game
Health Potion has been added to the game
Mana Potion has been added to the game
Doors have been added to the game (but do not currently exist in any of the main levels)
Enemies can now be inflicted with status ailments
MSAA has been removed from the camera rendering the game content. This should slightly sharpen the image, especially on larger displays
The tutorial should be functioning again
Key Guardians now have an icon matching the stairs they block
Water Elemental is no longer appearing as an extremely powerful Blue Slime
Fire Traps now warn you of impending attacks when you stand on them
Maps can now force spawn specific monsters. This makes some of the areas a bit more...flavorful
Very slightly reduced Par Times for Hero and Wizard
Fixed a rare issue regarding quitting the game when a thread is still awaiting a response from the server
'Enhanced Zap' is no longer in the Hero's class-specific trait pool
Minor bug fixes for the final boss fight

notes.title: Patch Notes - 10/11/2017
notes.content:
Change Summary (Spoiler-free):

A bunch of work has gone into preparing the game for a desktop release. The aspect ratio has been switched over to 16:9 to support more standard displays. 

A new telegraph system has been added. In addition to the "!" icon, enemies now pulse and telegraph some of their attacks. If a square will result in you taking damage next turn and is the result of an enemy directly attacking you, it will shine red. This change doesn't impact very fast players, but is designed to help newer/casual people keep up with the game and learn enemy patterns. In some cases (mainly the Dragon Key Guardian), additional tiles may glow red in order to teach you how their attacks work.

Un-targeted attacks (like the spells cast by bosses that nuke specific areas) will render an animated target reticle. Entering these damages you as well, but the icon is different in order to help indicate how the attack works.

Thanks to the new telegraph system, the Angel and Beholder are now showing up as enemies in Area 2. They may migrate elsewhere soon.

Traps have been added. For now there are Fire Traps in Area 2, but more are coming.

Music and SFX have been added to a bunch of areas and actions.

Experienced players may encounter a different boss in Area 1.

Misc bug and UI fixes. Probably added some new bugs as well



Known Issues:

The tutorial is horridly out of date

Some SFX are missing or don't make sense

Area 3 is no longer tuned properly.

Sometimes monsters under the effect of a certain shield don't render the effect. Their HP values do properly reflect it for now, though.



***SPOILERS*** New Content ***SPOILERS***:

The Beholder:
HP: 1
ATK: 3

Rotates clockwise every 3 turns. 1 turn after rotating, it telegraphs a laser, and fires it 1 turn after that. Entirely stationary, serves as more of a dynamic obstacle than an enemy.

Angel:
HP: 1
Shield: 3
ATK: -3

The angel seeks to heal and buff nearby allies. It will heal for 3 HP, and can apply a 3 HP shield to fully-healed targets. It will prioritize the nearest target that needs assistance (< max HP or no shield), and will branch out searching for targets that meet this criteria. Angels will not assist Rats or other Angels, primarily for balance reasons.

Fire Trap:
ATK: 3

Simply burns the area it occupies every 3 turns. If you're nearby, you'll be able to see how close it is to going off. If you're speed running, learn to count!

The Fairy Queen:
This is a new boss encounter that appears in Area 1 if you've beaten the game. It has a 50% chance to replace the Slime King. It's intended to essentially be an "expert" variation of the Slime King fight, and the same general tactics apply.

The Queen herself is virtually un-killable until you cross the two bridges and take out the weaker Fairies. Portals will periodically summon Moths. Learning to deal with the Moths here is tricky, as they behave entirely randomly. Good luck!
